user.title: Select Region
user.description: Choose the electricity market region for spot price prediction.

operator.title: Electricity Operator & Tariffs
operator.description: Select your network operator or choose 'Custom' to enter your own rates. Day rate applies Mon-Fri 07:00-22:00, night rate applies at other times.

data.seller_margin: Energy seller's margin (EUR/kWh, excl. VAT, from your contract)
data.nordpool_entity: Nordpool sensor entity ID (e.g., sensor.nordpool_kwh_fi_eur_3_10_0, leave empty to skip)

optional_apis.title: Optional Data Sources
optional_apis.description:
Cross-border prices (Tier 2) improve predictions using Swedish and Estonian price data — no API key needed. Fingrid data (Tier 3) adds nuclear production and cross-border power flow data — requires a free API key from data.fingrid.fi.

ApexCharts dashboard example: https://github.com/watti-matti/HA-spot-price-predictor/blob/main/docs/yaml_examples/apexcharts_dashboard.yaml

data.fingrid_api_key: Fingrid API key (optional, free at data.fingrid.fi)
data.enable_tier2: Enable cross-border price data (Sweden SE1/SE3, Estonia)

abort.already_configured: This integration is already configured. Use the Options button to change settings.

error.invalid_fingrid_key: Invalid Fingrid API key. Register for free at data.fingrid.fi.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to API. Check your network connection.

init.title: Spot Price Predictor Settings
init.description: Change your operator, tariffs, or API configuration. Select 'Custom' as operator to use your own day/night rates.
